name: Practiced Reconnoiter
body:
Your long days spent observing people, animals, and the wilderness has made you more keenly aware of your surroundings.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 3 Ranks

Benefit(s): Once per round, you may make a Perception check as free action and searching an area takes you only half the normal amount of time. In addition you gain a +2 bonus to initiative checks.
